notes: SOURCE: identical orange-and-white apartment buildings in snow under a black sky, ~-11 C, yellow streetlights, no day-night cycle; starts at the apartments; Level 11 buildings smaller and more vacant near the complex; no facelings; black metal barricades, gunshot dents on the Level 11 side; apartments, classrooms, lounges, infirmaries; fridges restock every other week with random Frontrooms food; wooden number signs beside gateway doors, return through the same door; Base Omicron (~250 people, linked to Base Epsilon on 283); Banner Building with geometric shapes and painted banners, only lit building, impenetrable invisible barrier, reported shadow figure, two tents and a constant watch; Jane's diary; walking away from the complex leads to Level 11; eight door gateways. ADAPTATION: layout (inner ring A-D around the courtyard, outer ring of identical blocks and sheet-metal barricades closing the gaps, approach road to the south) and 64 x 13 m 9-storey block size are ours; Block C's ground and first floors are the enterable interior and hold all eight gateway doors (room plan ours); the fridge cycle uses the real calendar (14 days) and taken food stays taken within a cycle (+15 HP, item 'frontrooms_food'); the specific foods are illustrative; base residents are not rendered (lit windows, generators, tents, radio and notices stand for them); the shadow figure appears on ~50% of 2-5 min checks when you stand south of the Banner Building within 60 m; sky and fog lighten toward Level 11 along the approach road; snowfall particles follow the player outdoors; sodium lamp heads are emissive panels on Poly Haven street lamps. QA fixture: none needed; the 283 door (first exit) is reachable from start through the Block C entrance.
